answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 44539 Country: Bangladesh Title: Name Question: My daughter's name is Zaariah Shakhawat. Is it a good Islamic name? What is the meaning of Zaariah and Shakhawat. Please reply. Answer ID: 44539 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 488/458/N=1434) According to Arabic language, the meaning of Zariah (زاریہ) is not good. It means: a woman who finds faults, one who disdains someone, one who rebukes, etc كذا في تاج العروس (38: 215-216) ومصباح اللغات (ص 337). Hence you should change the name of your daughter and keep any good and meaningful name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
